acceptanceCriteria.text: On Linux, when MCP_TEST_POSTGRES_CONNECTION or MCP_TEST_SQLSERVER_CONNECTION is not already set, InstallTestDependencies loads it from the test-database env file (default ~/.config/qbrain-test/test-db.env, overridable by the --test-db-env-file parameter) and exports it to the test processes the build starts; a variable already set is adopted unchanged.
It starts the containers qbrain-test-postgres and qbrain-test-sqlserver when they exist but are stopped, and never creates, stops, removes, or reconfigures any other container.

Before tests run it verifies that each endpoint named by a connection string accepts TCP connections, and fails with a clear message (no skip) when the env file, a variable, a container, or an endpoint is missing or unreachable.
Connection-string values never appear in logs, exception messages, or committed files; only variable names, file paths, container names and host:port endpoints are reported.
On Windows, the existing LocalDB and PostgreSQL binaries provisioning is unchanged.
MigrationIntegrationTests on Linux runs the Category=Integration provider tests against those endpoints and fails, never skips, when provisioning fails.

result.title: InstallTestDependencies provisions provider test servers on Linux
result.description: On Linux, InstallTestDependencies supplies the PostgreSQL and SQL Server endpoints of the Category=Integration provider tests from the host test-database env file and the dedicated qbrain-test containers (operator decision 2026-10-11, BUG-BASELINE-005), and exports them to the test processes the build starts; Windows provisioning is unchanged.
result.notes: PLAN-C4MODEL-001. Operator answers 2026-10-19: "Fix all 14 in this plan", "Fix 10 here; 4 via PR 82/83", "Trait + Linux provisioning (Recommended)".
